title: RFC 4180 CSV parser
prompt: Implement `parseCSV(text)` in src/csv.js returning an array of rows (arrays of strings) per RFC 4180: fields separated by commas, rows by LF or CRLF; fields may be quoted with double quotes, quoted fields may contain commas, CR/LF and doubled quotes (two double quotes mean one double quote); a trailing newline at the end of the text does not create an empty row; empty fields are empty strings; an empty input returns []. Throw a SyntaxError for an unterminated quoted field or for characters after a closing quote other than a comma or newline.
